user.About: A Computer Science undergraduate at BITS Pilani and a Cloud Architect at Wipro, working onsite for HPE on private, air-gapped cloud solutions built with HPE GreenLake. I'm passionate about cloud infrastructure, AI/ML and frontend development — and outside of tech I enjoy exploring the universe, photography, and sketching.

RandomAboutText: Things like 'Completed Projects' doesn't exsist in my life as I got an idea about a project and I start working on them. There's always something there which I find that can be improved. So every project is ongoing.
weekendIntro: Small side projects I built while learning machine learning algorithms — quick experiments, each one shipped as a tiny web app.

exp1.description: Featured in the Hacktoberfest 2023 Hall of Fame after completing the challenge — contributed to open-source projects with 4 pull requests accepted and merged.

exp2.description: Built and shipped responsive web interfaces remotely using HTML5, CSS3 and modern frontend tooling.

exp3.description: Joined under the Work Integrated Learning Program (WILP) — a scholarship to pursue a BTech from BITS Pilani alongside Wipro's work culture — working with DevOps and Azure DevOps Server.

exp4.description: Administered Windows Server environments with Microsoft Azure and Azure Active Directory as part of an on-site apprenticeship.

exp5.description: Managed and maintained IBM WebSphere application server environments on-site.

exp6.description: Architecting and implementing a private, disconnected (air-gapped) cloud solution for Hewlett Packard Enterprise (HPE) using HPE GreenLake — delivering secure, scalable infrastructure with zero public internet connectivity while maintaining enterprise-grade capabilities.

ishvarax.name: IshvaraX
ishvarax.description: A community platform for people who love to code — open freelance-style projects with applications, study materials organised by topic, a member-written blog, a showcase of shipped apps and an admin panel managing all of it.
ishvarax.tech_stack: Next.js 15, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS v4, Material 3, FastAPI

saturday.name: Saturday
saturday.description: A small framework for building and training your own voice assistant on a small language model — describe a persona, write a few example conversations, optionally add tools, and Saturday handles LoRA fine-tuning, speech in and out, speaker logins, and running the model on a free Colab GPU. Published on PyPI as saturday-ai; JERN is built on it.
saturday.tech_stack: Python, Hugging Face, PEFT (LoRA), llama.cpp, faster-whisper, Google Colab

jern.name: JERN
jern.description: Just an Experimental Response Network — a personal AI assistant with a cloud-GPU brain and local hands. A fine-tuned Qwen2.5-1.5B model runs on a free Colab GPU while file, shell, web-search and MCP tools execute on your own machine.
jern.tech_stack: Python, PyTorch, Hugging Face, FastAPI, MCP, Google Colab

lan.name: LAN-Analysis
lan.description: A Python-based local web app with a React.js UI that analyzes a star topology LAN network, providing details on connected devices, bandwidth usage, network interfaces, Wi-Fi, vEthernet, and DNS server information.

devbadges.name: DevBadges API | formerly Google Cloud Skill Boost Badges API
devbadges.description: Read-only API for showing off a dev profile — Google Cloud Skills Boost badges and GitHub achievements as JSON or embeddable SVG grids, plus a Google weather-card scraper. It powers the badges section on this site.

learnit.name: LearnIT | Open-Source Book distribution platform
learnit.description: A platform for distributing and accessing open-source books, enabling users to share and discover educational resources.

hiro.name: HIRO
hiro.description: Your personal healthcare companion — an ML model that analyzes reported symptoms and suggests likely conditions, wrapped in a simple web UI.

imageclf.name: ML Image Classification
imageclf.description: Groups images that resemble a sample image using ImageNet features extracted with Keras and ranked by cosine similarity — now served as a small web model.

tictactoe.name: TicTacToe AI
tictactoe.description: An unbeatable Tic-Tac-Toe agent using memoised minimax with a stateless FastAPI backend — ships as a single Vercel function and comes with an exhaustive test proving it never loses.
